zh: 修复音频文件在线试听与一键下载：支持 `/api/agent-files/view` 与 `/download` 专用路由并补齐音频 MIME 类型，确保声音创作成果直出播放器与文件下载。
全面支持「创建声音」免选工作目录直接调用：修复首页无工作目录普通对话下的技能路由与 Extra 工具集异常，无需关联本地文件夹即可即时合成声音。
全新上线「创建声音」（Voice Creator）受控高拟真语音创作技能：集成 Fish Audio 官方 12 款无版权安全音色，支持多轮交互选音色与情感副语言标记，API Key 保险箱加密托管。
en: Fix audio streaming preview and one-click download: add `/api/agent-files/view` and `/download` routes with complete audio MIME types, enabling direct playback and instant downloading.
Support Voice Creator without requiring workspace directory: fix skill routing and extra toolsets in root conversations, allowing instant voice generation without picking a local folder.
Introduce 'Voice Creator' high-fidelity TTS & voice crafting skill: integrate 12 official copyright-safe Fish Audio voices with interactive selection and vaulted credentials.
